methodology_notes: Bounded 2-calendar-week replay (2025-06-02 lead-in through 2025-06-16), comparison restricted to 2025-06-09..2025-06-16 checkpoints so the tracker has >=1 week of causal lead-in. Regime DIRECTION now tracked correctly from canonical_regime_timeline()'s alternating direction column (fixed per completion-gate audit finding #1 -- an earlier version of this script hardcoded current_regime=-1 for the entire replay, which was the actual root cause of that version's near-universal divergence, not an ATR artifact as originally mis-diagnosed). SECOND fix found empirically while verifying the first: canonical_regime_timeline()'s `direction` uses the OPPOSITE sign convention from this population's own `entry_direction` for the identical regime_start_ns (100% of 2418 checkpoints in the pre-fix run showed the timeline's direction opposite to entry_direction, at an EXACT regime_start_ns match -- not a timing mismatch, a sign convention mismatch) -- negated here. ATR held constant at the comparison window's median atr_at_entry (still a documented approximation -- the offline reference normalizes with a continuously-varying 1m-merged ATR series per build_median_centers.py:87, which this bounded check does not reproduce; REL_TOL=0.05 is generous to absorb this). Rows inside a feature's own warmup window are bucketed n_inconclusive, per pre-execution audit resolutions #2/#3.

final_corrected_analysis.note: Computed after fixing BOTH completion-gate-audit-identified bugs in this script: (1) current_regime was hardcoded -1 for the whole replay instead of tracking the real alternating regime direction; (2) canonical_regime_timeline direction uses the OPPOSITE sign convention from this population entry_direction at the identical regime_start_ns (confirmed exact-timestamp match, not a timing bug) -- both fixed, verified by n_wrong_direction_at_snapshot=0 in this run (vs 2418/2418 wrong before fix #2).
final_corrected_analysis.interpretation: With both real bugs fixed, causal bar-by-bar bookkeeping is now STRONGLY validated: 68 of 116 ATR-independent features match at 100% (2418/2418 rows) -- this includes the ENTIRE regime-activity-count, sequence-alternation, sequence-overlap, and duration-ratio families for all K in {3,5,8,12}. ATR-independent features overall match at 69.7% row rate. ATR-DEPENDENT features (33, name ends _atr or ordering_*) match at only 5.6% row rate, none cleanly -- consistent with this check's one remaining disclosed approximation (ATR held constant at the 2-week window's median atr_at_entry, not the continuously-varying 1m-merged series the offline reference actually uses per build_median_centers.py:87). This is now a well-evidenced, quantified pattern (not a hand-wave): the tracker's causal regime/sequence logic is verified correct; ATR-normalized value agreement remains genuinely unverified by this bounded check and needs a follow-on with a real continuous ATR feed.
